targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-740 (INV-064 maturational-sequence necessity) FAILed on the validity precondition only (PC_iv_moved): mean z_world eff_rank ratio 0.770 < 1.15 -- E1/E2 differentiation did NOT increase across the onset {2,5,11,22} schedule; it ran backwards (per-seed [0.855, 0.493, 0.962]). Root cause is measurement + design, not claim pressure: (a) eff_rank/participation-ratio of the alpha_world=0.9 EMA z_world sampled over a random-action replay DECREASES with maturation (a trained EMA latent specialises onto a low-dim task manifold), opposite to INV-064's 'differentiation' (task-relevant discriminability); (b) the onset window is entirely post-saturation -- E2 forward R2 ~0.99 at onset_2 -- so no immature anchor arm existed. INV-064 was therefore never testable here -> non_contributory, measurement_degeneracy; no weighting. Re-queued as corrected successor V3-EXQ-740a (task-relevant decodability observable + immature anchor + mature-anchor harm-decodability positive control; keeps the PC_iv_moved-style guard). INV-064 stays candidate / pending_substrate_reconfirmation. First INV-064 degenerate autopsy -- re-derive brake not fired; a second would implicate the operationalisation (route to test-bed/measurement redesign, not a third letter).

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: No substrate build owed. The substrate carries the information (E2 forward R2~0.99); the gap is the differentiation observable + onset window, both fixed inside the corrected 740a experiment design.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 does not apply. The two levers (task-relevant differentiation observable + immature anchor arm) are one coherent redesign, not a discrimination between mutually-exclusive hypotheses -- route to a single corrected 740a, per user selection.

learning_extracted: eff_rank / participation ratio is the wrong differentiation observable for an alpha_world=0.9 EMA world latent: over a random-action replay the covariance is drift-dominated and specialises onto a ~rank-1 task manifold as it matures, so effective rank DECREASES with training -- opposite to the task-relevant discriminability INV-064 means.

The onset window (2..22 episodes) sat entirely in the saturated regime -- E2 forward R2 ~0.99 at onset_2 means no genuinely-immature anchor existed; a correct metric still needs an immature arm (onset ~0-1 or an E1-capacity degradation arm).

Secondary (carry, do not over-read): held-out harm R2 is negative in ALL arms while E2 forward R2 ~0.99 -- z_world predicts its own dynamics but carries little held-out harm info at any maturity; confounded here by the vacuous IV. The 740a redesign should add a mature-anchor harm-decodability positive control before reading the gradient.
The PC_iv_moved non-degeneracy guard worked correctly -- it self-routed non_degenerate=false rather than emitting a spurious 'weakens'. No guard defect.
